newsitem.title: USA: Dames & Moore says to take charge $0.08/shr.
newsitem.headline: Dames & Moore says to take charge $0.08/shr.

text.p: Dames & Moore Group said Tuesday it will restructure its international operations and its construction management subsidiary O'Brien Kreitzberg and take a charge of about $0.08 per share in fiscal year 1997.
The company said it is disappointed in the results of these operations. The company said results have not yet been finalized for the fiscal year ended in March.
The company said that absent the expenses incurred in this restructuring, earnings per share for the 1997 fiscal year would have been slightly higher than the fiscal year 1996 results.
